title: Ling Yuan Appears
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's smile echoed through the void, yet Chen Ji felt a warning deep within the Tianji Record—the price of this deal was far heavier than it appeared.

text.content: The void tore apart, and an elderly yet incomparably dignified figure stepped slowly from the rift. Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, was now surrounded by faint golden fluctuations of law. Every step he took seemed to tread upon the pulse of heaven and earth. That oppressive aura, like mountains collapsing, instantly enveloped a hundred zhang in all directions, causing all three to have their breaths freeze for a moment.

dialogue.content: Calmly and unhurriedly landing before the three, Ling Yuan's lips carried a meaningful smile. His gaze first fell upon Chen Ji, then shifted to Chen Nian, as if looking at two treasures recovered after being lost. "Three children, you truly made this old man search hard."

text.content: Chen Ji's form slightly leaned forward, subtly positioning himself to shield Chen Nian. Ye Qing understood, and demonic path mist quietly spread a thin barrier around the three. Yet Ling Yuan merely raised his hand lightly, and that layer of mist dissolved like morning mist meeting the rising sun. "Mere trickery." His tone was mild, yet carried undeniable control.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression remained calm as usual, only a cold glint flickering deep in his eyes. He slightly bowed in greeting, his voice neither servile nor arrogant: "The former Sect Master personally visits—your disciple is overwhelmed. May I know what orders the former Sect Master has for this visit?" This posture perfectly played the part of atrash disciple, yet the fist hidden in his sleeve quietly tightened.

Ling Yuan laughed lightly, that laughter seeming capable of penetrating the deepest corners of the heart. "Had enough of the act?" His gaze suddenly turned sharp as a blade. "Heir of the Tianji Record, orphaned child of the Chen family—this old man has waited a long time for this day." At these words, the atmosphere in the field instantly dropped to freezing point.

text.content: Yet Ling Yuan shifted his words, and that suffocating oppressive aura actually slowly receded. "Did you think this old man was Heaven's lackey?" He clasped his hands behind his back, his expression even showing a hint of sneer. "Heaven's Eye is merely a self-important chess player. How could it understand this old man's ambition?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan took a step forward, his gaze falling upon Chen Nian, a complex emotion flashing in his eyes. "This child's abilities should not be exploited by Heaven's Eye." His voice lowered. "This old man has a proposal—let us join hands to deal with Heaven's Eye together. In exchange, I want to share part of the power awakened from the Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Chen Nian suddenly broke free from Chen Ji's hand and stepped forward. Her voice carried a tremor, yet also a familiar certainty: "Senior Ling Yuan... do you still remember what you told me under the old locust tree in the Chen residence all those years ago?" This sudden question tightened Chen Ji's heart—his sister and this old fox actually had an old acquaintance?

Ling Yuan's expression flickered with a momentary daze, and upon that always composed face, an rare trace of tenderness actually appeared. "Little girl, you still remember." He sighed softly. "Your father entrusted you to this old man's care back then, yet the Holy Sect people took you away first. This debt, this old man has always remembered."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart rang alarm bells. The Tianji Record quivered violently at this moment, as if warning of something. He calculated rapidly—Ling Yuan having an old connection with his father was outside his expectations, yet also within reason. But was this "old affection" genuine or scheming? And his sister's attitude toward Ling Yuan was clearly more intimate than toward him as a brother—there must be something hidden here.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's proposal was both unexpected and full of hidden mysteries. Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Reject Ling Yuan's proposal on the spot, using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to test his true attitude. High risk, high reward—may force out Ling Yuan's trump card, or expose one's own strength.
choices.visible_cost: Costs 10 Heavenly Fate points, may expose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: See through Ling Yuan's true strength and stance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's cultivation is深不可测, direct conflict would be extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes suddenly turned sharp, and the Tianji Record roared into operation within his Mental Sea, golden patterns spreading along his meridians to his fingertips. Just as he was about to strike, he saw Ling Yuan slightly sidestep, and in those eyes was even a hint of approval. "Impatient." The former Sect Master said calmly. "Did you think this old man's thousand years of cultivation were merely decoration?"

choices.description: Pretend to agree to cooperation, actually use Ling Yuan's power against Heaven's Eye to buy time for one's own development. Go with the flow, use enemies against enemies—risk is relatively controllable.
choices.visible_cost: May owe Ling Yuan a favor
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely scheming, may have ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji pondered briefly, then suddenly broke into a smile, that smile perfectly carrying the helplessness of someone convinced. "Since the former Sect Master had an old bond with my father and is willing to fight Heaven's Eye with us, how could your disciple possibly refuse?" His tone was sincere, yet the Tianji Record in his sleeve secretly calculated countless possibilities for dealing with Ling Yuan's betrayal.

choices.description: Make no statement, neither accept nor refuse—present a weaktrash posture, observe what unknown connection exists between Ling Yuan and Chen Nian. Take time to plan, strike after the enemy reveals themselves.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence, preserve trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may lean toward Ling Yuan more due to your silence

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, assuming a hesitant expression. "This matter... your disciple cannot decide alone, need to discuss with my younger sister." His voice carried appropriate hesitation. "I wonder if the former Sect Master could give us a moment?" Ling Yuan looked at him with a knowing smile. "You are quite cautious. Very well, this old man awaits your answer."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped forward, the aura of the Demonic Path Holy Sect's Saint as cold as frost. Her voice carried a warning: "Senior Ling Yuan, cooperation is possible, but words alone mean nothing. You need to show sufficient sincerity—for instance, tell us what Heaven's Eye's true purpose is." Her question hit the vital point, clearly also probing this former Sect Master's bottom line.

Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan's gaze fell upon Ye Qing, even showing a hint of appreciation. "The Saint of the Demonic Path Holy Sect is indeed no ordinary person." He slowly spoke, his voice seeming to come from ancient times. "Heaven's Eye does not seek the rise or fall of any single sect, but wants to restart the laws of heaven and earth, returning the entire cultivation world to chaos. And the Tianji Record... is the key it must reclaim."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart was掀起惊涛骇浪. The Tianji Record's tremors grew increasingly violent, as if corroborating Ling Yuan's words. He rapidly recalled the fragments Master Mo had revealed—the Tianji Record truly was part of Heaven's Will, used to balance the world's prophetic powers. If what Ling Yuan said was true, then what did that make himself? A rebel against the Tianji Record, or something else entirely?

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's proposal was fully laid out. Chen Ji needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan proactively revealed Heaven's Eye's purpose, might as well follow the vine to get the melon—inquire about his true relationship with the Tianji Record, and what his "independent purpose" actually is.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely scheming, may not tell the truth

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared directly into Ling Yuan's eyes, the sharpness hidden beneath histrash exterior fully revealed at this moment. "The former Sect Master says Heaven's Eye wants to restart the world—then what about you? You say you want to share the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, but for what purpose?" His voice was not loud, yet carried unavoidable pressure. "Your disciple wishes to know—what is your true purpose in cooperating with us?"

choices.description: Chen Nian and Ling Yuan seem to have an old connection—this is not suitable to inquire about publicly. While Ling Yuan is unaware, privately ask Chen Nian with sibling affection, understand what their connection truly is, then decide.
choices.visible_reward: Gain sister's trust, understand the situation
choices.risk_hint: Doing this in front of Ling Yuan may appear not trusting him

text.content: Chen Ji gently held Chen Nian's hand, his gaze tender yet serious. "Little Nian, what is your relationship with Senior Ling Yuan?" This inquiry was kept extremely low, only audible to the siblings. Chen Nian's body slightly stiffened, her lips moving, as if countless words were lodged in her throat. "Brother, he... he said he would protect us."

Ling Yuan observed everything yet did not rush them. He clasped his hands behind his back, his robes fluttering in the void. Those deep eyes seemed capable of piercing through time and causality. "This old man knows you won't believe easily." His tone was calm as water. "But some things, when you witness Heaven's Eye's madness with your own eyes, you will naturally understand." As his words fell, an arcane rune flew from his fingertips, floating before Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "This is a Causality Token." Ling Yuan's voice carried undeniable authority. "If this old man has even a hint of falsehood, this object will naturally backlash. But if you choose cooperation, it will become an unbreakable covenant between us." His gaze swept over Ye Qing and Chen Nian, finally landing on Chen Ji. "Of course, if you insist on refusing, this old man will not force you. But... are you truly prepared to face Heaven's Eye alone?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He gazed down at the floating rune, the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea giving countless calculation results—accepting cooperation, might be schemed against by Ling Yuan; refusing cooperation, would immediately face this thousand-year-old monster's hostility; and if pretending to cooperate while secretly planning... the Tianji Record's tremors reached their peak at this moment, as if reminding him that whichever path, was filled with thorns.

choice.prompt: The Causality Token floats before his eyes. Ling Yuan awaits an answer.

choices.description: Take the token, superficially reach cooperation with Ling Yuan, actually secretly set up countermeasures for future betrayal. This is Chen Ji's most skilled tactic—play the pig to eat the tiger, plan secretly.
choices.visible_cost: Must constantly guard against Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing room, secretly develop forces
choices.risk_hint: The Causality Token may constrain more than just Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand. The moment his fingertips touched the rune, a strange power surged into his body. A fitting gravity appeared on his face. "Since it has come to this, your disciple is willing to join hands with the former Sect Master." Before the words even finished, Master Mo's voice from deep within the Tianji Record sounded faintly: "Boy, are you sure?" Chen Ji smirked in his heart—sure? The moment he started planning, he was already prepared for betrayal.

choices.description: Accepting directly seems too eager—better to retreat strategically, propose some favorable conditions for yourself, both appearing cautious and testing Ling Yuan's bottom line.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may think you insufficiently sincere

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression sincere yet somewhat troubled. "Your disciple has felt the former Sect Master's sincerity. However... the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key requires Little Nian to willingly awaken it—your disciple cannot decide for her." He paused, then shifted topics. "Perhaps like this—during the cooperation period, could the former Sect Master bestow some... protective items, so we may have peace of mind." This statement was watertight, both kicking the ball back to Ling Yuan and gaining practical benefits for himself.

Ling Yuan stared at Chen Ji for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter. That laughter actually contained genuine appreciation. "Good, good, good!" He said three good words in succession. "This old man has lived a thousand years, yet never met a young person so meticulous in thinking. Your father back then... may not have matched you either." With that, he waved his sleeve, and three Jade Slips appeared out of thin air, floating before the three. "This is this old man's sincerity—the Tianqing Sect's sect-founding cultivation art, and two Concealment Talismans that can escape Heaven's Eye's perception."

text.content: Ye Qing accepted one Concealment Talisman, a hint of surprise flickering in her eyes. The grade of this talisman was high enough to prove Ling Yuan's sincerity was by no means empty words. But she also knew—the easier such benefits came by, the more dangerous they usually were. "Doesn't the senior fear us taking the goods without doing the work?" She stared directly at Ling Yuan. "The Causality Token can constrain those who betray, but cannot constrain those who, after obtaining benefits, choose to seclude themselves and avoid the world."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's gaze toward Ye Qing grew increasingly profound. "Does the Saint think, why did this old man specifically choose you all?" His voice was low and certain. "Because you have no retreat. Heaven's Eye has already set its sights on you—failing to join hands now means waiting for death." He turned to Chen Nian. "Moreover... little girl, how long can the power sealed within you still be suppressed? Three years? Five years? When Heaven's Eye comes knocking by then, what will you do?"

text.content: Chen Nian's face abruptly turned pale. She instinctively covered her heart, where something was stirring restlessly. Chen Ji's heart tightened—he had never heard his sister mention having a seal within her. Ling Yuan knew far more than they had imagined. He suppressed the stormy waves in his heart, yet his face remained unmoved. "The former Sect Master seems quite knowledgeable about my younger sister."

Ling Yuan clasped his hands behind his back, his gaze shifting from Chen Nian to the distant horizon. There, dark clouds churned faintly, as if some terrifying existence was approaching. "Time is running out." His voice was low. "Heaven's Eye's chess pieces have already begun their layout. At most half a year, the Great Era's struggle will fully erupt.届时，要么你们成为执棋之人，要么……沦为弃子。" His words were like heavy hammers, striking each person's heart one blow after another.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, finally extending his hand to accept that Causality Token. The rune slowly merged into his palm, becoming an invisible mark. "Very well." His voice was calm, yet carried undeniable resolve. "Your disciple is willing to cooperate with the former Sect Master. But let me be clear—if the former Sect Master harbors any intention harmful to my Chen family, this Causality Token... may not be unable to kill an old monster." The last sentence was spoken lightly, yet caused a genuine glint of wariness to flash in Ling Yuan's eyes.

text.content: Ling Yuan stared at Chen Ji for a long time, then suddenly smiled. That smile actually carried genuine heartfelt appreciation. "Very well, this old man will remember it." He turned, his robes fluttering in the void. "Three days later, at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, this old man awaits you. By then... other allies will be present." Before the words even finished, his figure had transformed into flowing light, disappearing into the void.

After Ling Yuan departed, silence briefly filled the field. Ye Qing spoke first, her voice heavy: "He knows too much. His sister's seal, Heaven's Eye's layout, even our grievances with the Holy Sect... he knows everything." Her gaze fell on Chen Ji. "Do you really intend to trust him?"

Chen Ji did not answer. He gazed down at the faintly visible mark on his palm, the Tianji Record's calculation results flashing rapidly through his mind. "Trust?" He laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of coldness. "I never trust anyone. I simply... temporarily need this chess piece." His gaze turned to Chen Nian, his voice softening. "Little Nian, tell me, what exactly did Ling Yuan say to you?"

Chen Nian was silent for a long while before finally speaking. Her voice carried a tremor, yet also a sense of relief. "When I was little... Father entrusted me to Senior Ling Yuan for a period of care. Back then he taught me cultivation, and also said one thing—" She paused, her eyes slightly reddening. "He said, 'If one day your brother finds you, tell him—the true secret of the Tianji Record lies hidden in the Chen family ancestral land.'"

Chen Ji was shaken to his core. The Chen family ancestral land—that was a place his father never mentioned, a realm he had never touched. The Tianji Record quivered violently at this moment, as if sensing something. He took a deep breath, suppressed his emotions. "It seems... we have another destination." The corner of his mouth slightly lifted, yet a sharp cold glint flashed in his eyes. Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, you think yourself the chess player, but in this game of chess, who is the chess piece remains to be seen.
